title: Awesome and would buy again
text: Awesome and would buy again. Love this and use it to hang our coffee mugs...it looks amazing and is super functional

product_metadata.title: Claimed Corner Wall Mounted Coffee Mug Rack - Large Rustic Black Iron Steel Kitchen Rack with 6 Rows - Storage for 27 Cups - Jar & Plate Holder - Vertical Display Organizer - Farmhouse Home Décor
features: 38" x 20.5" x 3" VERTICAL WALL MUG HOLDER: This coffee and tea mug hanger is an all-in-one station for kitchenware and accessories. Don't clutter up your counter or table. With 27 prongs, this is larger than other racks.

VERSATILE ORGANIZATION: Not just for mugs! Hang plates, bowls, mason jars, glasses, utensils, cooking supplies, and other hangable items. Or, take it outside the kitchen, and use it with scarves, towels, jewelry, or a festive holiday display.

EASY TO INSTALL: Upper and lower keyhole mounting brackets are built in and spaced 16” apart for easy installation into wall studs. Also included is all the hardware you will need to assemble and mount your beautiful new mug rack.
QUALITY STEEL CONSTRUCTION: Made of solid, forged metal to last a lifetime. Removable Rubber Caps are included for each mug hook that will help protect the inside of your treasured mugs.
